errors_found: verify/draft SM passes: the DFlash programme was always emitted in the as-built 8-slot SM records (param [4:2] 3 b) and 4-slot LM-head passes, and the P-lane rule then charged ceil(8/P) line passes a record: P=4 and P=6 both paid 4 weight passes for 16 positions (should be 4 and 3) and every head paid 4 passes at any P; P=8 alone dropped to 2 passes, hence +2% P4->P6 then +41% at P8
ATT pass merging: the group index was read from the tag .g<s0>, which carries the first SLOT (0,4,8,12), so j % P merged nothing at P=2/4 and merged the wrong groups at P=6/8
qwen_dflash_check_1018.fix: compiler record-size choice R in {P, 2P, 8, 16} (SM slot field 4 b per the ISA/SM change list; SM record cost ceil(R/P) line passes, ceil(B/R) per-pass records) and head pass PH in {16,8,6,4}, largest fitting the P-lane VM (2^18 + (P-1) x 30k words, TP4 map, conservative); slot count read from the x descriptor rows; ATT group index = slot / 4. P=1 unchanged (as built). tools/hgi_sim/hbm_plane_model.py, dflash.VM_WORDS

checks.draft_cost: charged per PASS (drafter weights 5 BF16 layers re-read ceil(R/P) x a record), not per position: P=8 drafter SM ~0.28M cycles (0.22 AR step)
checks.verify_passes: P=8 verify weights 1.745M = 2.00 x AR's 0.898M (ceil(16/8) = 2); P=6 3 line passes, P=4 4
checks.tau: tok/s = tau x clk / step; tau = accepted tokens a step incl. the bonus token (published 8.01 MATH-500 B200; measured 3.656 our 264-turn cycle-weighted); same tau at every P (block fixed at 16)
checks.per_position_costs: P=8 step 3.93M cycles = 3.10 AR steps: target weights 2 passes 1.75M, drafter ~0.28M, LM heads 4 passes 0.31M (15 draft + 16 verify slots, 8 a pass), and per-position work that P lanes do not amortise: TP all-reduce of 16 x H payload 0.46M (AR 0.10M; 64 B/cycle serialisation ESTIMATE, the largest priced term), softmax over 8K scores x 16 slots 0.36M (AR 0.04M), per-slot norms 0.17M, attention 0.23M (AR 0.09M), argmax 0.07M; non-SM work sits on the layer dependency chain (SM busy 2.33M of 3.93M)
checks.kv_8k: verify reads the 8K FP8 context once per P-lane ATT pass (P groups of 4 slots) plus the block rows; drafter context BF16 once
checks.same_pipeline: AR and DFlash use the same d4g cost chain (Q.d4g_added + relay knob + TP-8 sm_s/bw_s + COLL flit adders); DFlash swaps in dflash_timing for ATT (identical formula with B + C rows), all-reduce (+256 cycles per further 4,096 words) and TOKX; P=1 reproduces the earlier 20.92M step exactly

qwen_dflash_check_1018.conclusion: the +2%/+41% shape was a modelling error (fixed). DFlash below AR is NOT an error: with the published tau it beats AR from P=4 (1.55x) to P=8 (2.58x); with our measured tau 3.656 a 16-position step costs 3.1-5.2 AR steps, so it reaches AR only at P=8 (1.18x)
